name: Improved Tetrahedral Mesh Generation for Voxelization
definition: A robust voxelization framework that takes a triangular mesh as input and produces solid binary voxel data. It generates a high-quality tetrahedral mesh within a user-defined error bound to handle low-quality, non-watertight, or topologically open meshes that cause other methods to fail.
summary: Improved Tetrahedral Mesh Generation for Voxelization is a robust framework that converts triangular meshes into voxel data by combining background grid insertion with mesh improvement to handle low-quality inputs.
